{{Quote|The renegade Stazi and his entire fleet dropped out of nowhere! They're virtually on top of us, Admiral Kelsan!|Furske|<ref name="Legacy 36" />}}
'''Furske''' was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]. By [[137 ABY]], Furske was stationed aboard the [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]]
[[Avenger (Pellaeon-class)|''Avenger'']]. Assigned to the [[Coruscant Third Fleet]], the ''Avenger'' was tasked with protecting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], when the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] and the [[Empire-in-exile]] launched a surprise [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|attack]] on the fleet, intending to seize as many Imperial ships as possible. After the initial strike by the [[Gar Stazi]]'s fleet, Furske reported to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Peto Kelsan]] that the fleet's ships sustained some damage but had already raised their shields and were returning fire. When the [[Bastion Second Fleet]], under the command of Admiral [[Edouard Fenel]], arrived to reinforce Stazi, Furske quickly calculated that Krayt's Empire was badly outnumbered. Fenel demanded the surrender of the Coruscant Third Fleet's ships, but Kelsan instead ordered that all ships be set to self-destruct while the crews left in the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. Kelsan chose to stay on the ''Avenger'' and perished with its explosion.<ref name="Legacy 36" />
